---
title: "Sampling-to-first-report turnaround"
date: 2026-08-24
format: html
execute:
  echo: true
  warning: false
  message: false
---

Turnaround is the calendar-day difference between sampling and the first
report date. Missing date pairs and negative intervals are excluded and
counted.

```{r}
#| label: turnaround

source(here::here("R", "data-helpers.R"))

samples_path <- here::here(
  "analysis", "00-data", "results", "analysis-ctdna-samples.parquet"
)
result_dir <- here::here("analysis", "04-implementation", "results")
summary_path <- file.path(result_dir, "turnaround-summary.parquet")
values_path <- file.path(result_dir, "turnaround-values.parquet")
dir.create(result_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

samples <- arrow::read_parquet(samples_path) |>
  as.data.frame()

turnaround_days <- as.numeric(report_date - sample_date)

values <- data.frame(
  turnaround_days = turnaround_days[!is.na(turnaround_days)]
)

turnaround_summary <- data.frame(
  n_samples = nrow(samples),
  n_valid_date_pairs = nrow(values),
  n_excluded_missing_or_invalid = nrow(samples) - nrow(values),
  median_days = if (nrow(values) > 0L) median(values$turnaround_days) else NA_real_,
  q1_days = if (nrow(values) > 0L) quantile(values$turnaround_days, 0.25) else NA_real_,
  q3_days = if (nrow(values) > 0L) quantile(values$turnaround_days, 0.75) else NA_real_,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
arrow::write_parquet(turnaround_summary, summary_path, compression = "zstd")
arrow::write_parquet(values, values_path, compression = "zstd")
```

```{r}
#| label: turnaround-summary
#| tbl-cap: "Sampling-to-report turnaround summary"
#| echo: false

turnaround_summary |>
  knitr::kable()
```
